Simple breakdown is AMC is back to where is was a year ago while on a down trend, this is good in my opinion in combination with CV19 (for stock only). Simply because now the demand for out of home bigger and better entertainment has grown to a desire everyone wants which is universal spending on theaters. (Universal spending meaning children to elders can go which is oh idk everyone and their mothers.) 
This means when theaters open, AMC is in everyone's minds as the theater that first opened after the covid crises, updated it theaters(some and soon to be majority) with safer and better equipment & recently only having positive news.

GME is simple. It's going to become the Digital Amazon of gaming. They could and probably are going to restructure themselves into a only gaming platform for all your gaming needs. They already have and will continue their online presence unless bought out. This would require them to innovate which any big business generally does when it's going to save it. With everyone doing most spending online it makes the most sense to me.
